lawyer: TH Khan with Gour Gopal Saha, Advocates ----- For the Accused-Appellant
parties:
Niranjan Deb ------ Accused-Appellant 
vs.
State ------ Respondent
full_judgment:
4. From the trend of cross-examination of PWs and the statement made by the accused- appellant under section 342 of the Code of Criminal Procedure the defence case appears to be that on the date of occurrence i.e. 2.11.85 there was a heavy transaction rush at the cash counter and the payment against the disputed cheque was made by him in the usual course of business and in bonafide good faith as the cheque was duly passed for payment by the Passing Officer, and it also had necessary endorsement by the concerned Ledger Clerk. After the transaction hours it was detected that the said payment of Taka 60,000.00 was obtained by some unknown person fraudulently and the Branch Manager finding the accused-appellant weak, illegally detained him in the bank premises and managed to call his other relations and exerted tremendous pressure upon them for making good the loss suffered by the bank and under such compelling circumstances the relations of the accused-appellant undertook to pay the money within twenty-four hours. And on the following day his said relations managed to raise the fund with the help and contributions of other bank officials and paid off the amount whereupon the accused-appellant was allowed to leave the bank premises. Thereafter, a Departmental Inquiry, headed by a very high ranking officer of the Bank was held, which revealed that the appellant did not misappropriate the amount in question and he was reinstated in his service. 

 12. It however, appears from evidence that the said account belongs to one Iqbal Hossain. The Manager PW 4 has stated in his cross-examination that account holder of the disputed account was Md. Iqbal Hossain. 

 14. The Manager of the Branch (PW 4) has stated in his examination in chief that the payment of Taka 60,000.00 was made against a fake cheque but he stated in his cross-examination that "গত ১.১১.৮৫ তাং এর সঞ্চয়ী হিসাবের চেকের নমুনা না দেখে বলতে পারি না যে প্রদর্শনী ৩ নমুনার চেক ও উক্ত সময় চালু ছিল কি না।” Further PW 5 Senior Officer, Cash, stated in his cross-examination that : "প্রদর্শী-৩ ধরনের চেক আমাদের ব্যাংকে ব্যবহার করা হয়।" 

 17. PW 4 has stated in his examination in chief that the signatures of the passing officer and ledger clerk appearing on the disputed cheque are forged. But in cross-examination he has said that. "ঐ চেকের পিছনে টোকেন নং-২৫৯৩২ লেখা আছে এবং দস্তখত আছে। ঐ চেকে লেজারের ফলিও নং-৩৬৯ লেখা আছে ও দস্তখত আছে। লেজার নম্বর লেখা নাই। ঐ চেকে পাসিং অফিসারের দস্তখত আছে। 

 20. PW 7 the Ledger Keeper has stated in his examination in chief that before any payment is made against a cheque, the cheque goes to him for his clearance and after due examination of the ledger he puts his signature. The disputed cheque, he said, did not contain his signature. And in cross-examination he stated that at the relevant time there was another ledger clerk Mahbubur Rahman. 

 27. PW 5 Abdur Rahim, Senior Officer Cash, has stated in his examination in chief that he made the payment of Taka 20,00,000.00 against the said token No. 25932 Article Ext. 1, but he said that after payment he delivered the token to the accused-appellant for making entry in the cash scroll. In cross-examination he however stated that: “ ২০,০০,০০০.০০ টাকার পেমেন্ট ২.১১.৮৫ তারিখ নিজে করি এবং টোকেন ও চেক আমার নিজের কাছে রাখি। আসামীর নিকট টোকেন ও চেক আমার নিজের কাছে রাখি। আসামীর নিকট টোকেন ও চেক দেওয়ার সময় কোন কাগজে এন্টি করে দেই নাই।” 

 28. Further PW 6 Abdul Kalam Bhuiyan, Senior Cashier-cum-Clerk, stated in chief that accused-appellant Niranjan Deb on the relevant date was on duly at payment counter No. 1 and in his cross-examination said that on the date of occurrence 100 tokens were issued in the morning and after those tokens were used, the said tokens were re-issued. It is very likely that on the 2nd day of the month the transactions would be heavy. And there is not reason why the evidence of PW 6 cannot be relied upon. Furthermore, without the examination of the token clerk it cannot be said that the token in question was not issued against the disputed cheque. Thus it appears the finding of the Special Judge that a token cannot be used twice in the same day is not based on evidence. 

 29. In cross-examination PW 4 the Manager has admitted that as per direction of the DGM who visited the bank on the date of the occurrence at about 3 PM the Manager took step to recover the money from the accused-appellant and he also stated in his examination-in-chief that the younger brother of the accused-appellant and his other relations came to the bank and gave a written undertaking that they would manage to pay the said sum of Taka 60,000.00 within 5-00 PM of the following day. PW has stated in his cross-examination that "ঘটনার ব্যাংক কর্মরত পুলিশ আসামীকে ৩.১১.৮৫ তাং পর্যন্ত ব্যাংক আটক রাখে।"
